feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 15 November 2026 11:30am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Sunday, 15 November 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Rain will continue at first, possibly heavy for a time, before clearing to isolated showers through the afternoon. The light to moderate southwest wind will veer northwest and strengthen as the last of the rain clears through. Maximum temperature 10°C.

Clear intervals and the risk of isolated showers overnight into Monday, with a small risk of these showers turning wintry over higher ground. Minimum temperature of -1°C on higher ground and in the central valley, which will bring a risk of frost and ice.

Mainly dry with bright or sunny spells during the daytime, then cloud thickens through the evening with a band of rain arriving around midnight. Fresh to strong northwest winds become light and variable for a time during the day, before becoming easterly in the afternoon, then increasing strong to gale force later. Top temperature of 8°C.


##Outlook##

Rain continuing through the night into Tuesday, turning heavy at times, and initially wintry on higher ground before temperatures rise. Minimum temperature 1°C .

The persistent band of rain clears in the morning, though intermittent spells of rain continue for much of the day. Strong to gale force east winds gradually easing. Top temperature 10°C.


##Sunrise##

7:47am Tomorrow


##Sunset##

4:17pm Tomorrow
